title: "SCA Minhag of the Week 198: "Tefilla BeSibbur: Shabbat Shira (Beshalah)"

chapters.title: Tefillah and Zemirot on Shabbat Shira
Makam and Pizmonim
chapters.about: Makam Ajam and Tu Bishvat tunes

summary: Mr. Harari discusses various minhagim associated with Shabbat Shira and Parashat Beshalah. He covers the singing of the shira, specific pizmonim, the practice of tarha aruka during the reading of the Sefer Torah, and customs related to the reading of the Aseret HaDibrot.
questions: How is the shira sung by the kahal on Shabbat Shira?
What is the significance of the tarha aruka during the reading of the Sefer Torah?
Is banging one's feet at the mention of Amalek a formal minhag?
What is the custom of Ibtida Kalam and when is it performed?
